Imported from the user's Downloads directory on 2026-09-20. Source contents
are preserved; download suffixes are removed from destination filenames.
The two bundles remain separate because their formats and entrypoints differ.

| `README(6) (1).md` | `optimized/README.md` |
| `crg_fast (1).py` | `optimized/crg_fast.py` |
| `crg_core.cpp` | `optimized/crg_core.cpp` |

This is an external source import, not an admitted candidate or a completed
Gamma experiment. No compilation, tests, benchmarks, or prize qualification
were performed during import. Claims in the supplied READMEs remain attributed
to those documents, not independently confirmed here.

Only the seven supplied files are included. Referenced tests, Makefiles,
benchmark scripts, proofs, and evidence bundles were not supplied with this
import. Authorship and license closure must be established before promotion
or inclusion in a counted submission. Existing measured candidates and the
parked relational-binding experiment are unchanged.
